provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 1906 CASTROVILLE RD, SAN ANTONIO, TX, 78237

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Posted in Each Room: Three classrooms did not have the evacuation maps posted in the classroom. Note: This was corrected at inspection when evacuation maps were posted in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Posted in Each Room (26 TAC §746.5207(b))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: During the inspection, 14 bucket seats in two infant classrooms were observed without safety straps to secure the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: Three of four staff files evaluated did not have health and safety trainings available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: All four infant bottles in the Infant 0-6 month old classroom had no labels on the bottles with their names.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: During the course of the investigation, it was noted operation staff failed to provide adequate supervision due to daily incidents where children are fighting among themselves while in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Suspension and Expulsion: Throughout the investigation, it was observed that the operational policy lacks provisions for the processes of suspension and expulsion.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Suspension and Expulsion (26 TAC §746.501(a)(8))

occurrences.finding: School-age Furnishings and Equipment - Age-appropriate Rest Equipment: During the investigation, it was noted school-aged children were napping on the class floor.
occurrences.violation_type_title: School-age Furnishings and Equipment - Age-appropriate Rest Equipment (26 TAC §746.2705(2))

occurrences.finding: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone: During the inspection, it was determined that an individual present at the operation does not have a valid background check.        Note:  This was corrected when background check was re-submitted to change Role Type during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone (26 TAC §745.621(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you contract with someone who requires a background check: During the inspection, it was determined that an individual present at the operation does not have a valid background check completed for this operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you contract with someone who requires a background check (26 TAC §745.621(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you contract with someone who requires a background check: During the course of this investigation, it was found that the staff member who accompanied the child in the ambulance to the hospital had not completed a valid background check for this operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you contract with someone who requires a background check (26 TAC §745.621(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk: During the course of the investigation, it was determined that a child was left unattended outside on 11/21/2025. The operation did not notify the parent.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk (26 TAC §746.307(b)(4))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: During the course of the investigation, it was determined that a child was left unattended outside on 11/21/2025. The incident was not reported to Child Care Regulation (CCR) until 1/27/2026.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: During the course of the investigation, it was determined that a child was left unattended outside on 11/21/2026.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: One caregiver in classroom D-12 was observed working in the classrooms supervising children without receiving a background check and letter of eligibility.     NOTE: This was corrected at inspection when the caregiver left the operation and a background check was submitted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages: At time of inspection multiple  caregivers were unable to provide the ages of the children in their class.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: During the inspection, it was observed that infants seated in restrictive devices were not properly secured with straps.     This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages: At time of inspection two toddler caregivers were unable to provide the ages of the children in their class.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Arrangement of Napping Equipment - Not Blocking Entrances or Exits: Napping children were observed placed in front of exits in multiple classrooms. This was corrected when the director moved each child away from the exits.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Arrangement of Napping Equipment - Not Blocking Entrances or Exits (26 TAC §746.2909(1))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Use Sanitary Holders: In toddler room, the children were served crackers without a plate or napkin. This was corrected when it was addressed with the caregiver and caregiver provided plastic plates for the children to eat their snack on.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Use Sanitary Holders (26 TAC §746.3317(6))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: A caregiver did not wash an infant's hands after changing their diaper. This was corrected when the caregiver was reminded about handwashing procedures and the caregiver washed the infant's hands.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: Cleaning solutions and chemicals were observed under the sinks in three children's restrooms without child safety locks.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Use Sanitary Holders: Crackers were served on a bare table for children to eat from.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Use Sanitary Holders (26 TAC §746.3317(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: The following personnel records were not available for review at time of inspection: proof of education, notarized  Affidavit for Applicants for Employment form, proof of background check eligibility letter, copy of photo ID, and signed statement employees recieved copies of operational policies and employee policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle: A vehicle that is used to transport children is not equipped with an electronic child safety alarm.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle (26 TAC §746.5625(a))

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - No Overlap: A piece of outdoor play equipment was observed in front of a slide on the playground. The equipment overlapped the slide's required use zone.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - No Overlap (26 TAC §746.4805(d))

occurrences.finding: Handwashing Sink in Diaper-Changing Area: An infant classroom with a diaper-changing area does not have a handwashing sink.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Handwashing Sink in Diaper-Changing Area (26 TAC §746.4403(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Children were observed using a restroom in a room filled with stacks of boxes and other storage items.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: Based off information gathered, a child was bitten by another child when the classroom was out of ratio by one child. There were 6 infants present with a specified age group of 15 months with only one caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries: Based off information gathered, a parent wasn't notified at pick up the same day their child was bitten by another child. The parent was notified two days later.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries (26 TAC §746.307(c))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Five of ten children's files did not contain up to date immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: Three of twenty two caregivers did not have a current CPR/First Aid certificate on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: During inspection it was observed that one caregiver had 8 children in care ages 8 month, 9 month, 9 month, 9 month, 10 month, 10 month, 12 month, and 18 month.  Based on the ages of the children caregiver is out of ratio.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Caregiver's used poor judgment when they failed to touch the playground equipment that is unshaded, ensuring the playground equipment was cool enough for children to play.   This resulted in a child receiving a burn on abdomen area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: Two fire extinguishers in the center vans have not been serviced, as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §746.5307(b))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.  The last fire inspection was conducted on 8/3/2020.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))
